selected.rationale: The Fitness Enthusiast focuses heavily on performance apparel, technical fabrics, and athlete endorsements. This aligns directly with the advertiser's high-end technical outerwear for backcountry skiers worn by professional patrollers.
The Affluent Classic values quality, longevity, heritage, and craftsmanship over trends, matching the $650+ luxury price tier and craftsmanship values of the technical outerwear shells.

The Sustainability Buyer researches supply chains and looks for specific sustainability claims and certifications, fitting the durable, long-lasting gear philosophy required for serious backcountry skiing.

rejected.reason: The Wellness Optimizer focuses on supplements, clean beauty, and sleep tracking rather than outdoor technical apparel and gear.
The Busy Parent seeks convenience-motivated household products and subscriptions, whereas this advertiser sells high-end one-off luxury ski shells.
The Gen Z Aesthete prefers low-cost aesthetic-forward items with typical AOV around $48, which clashes with a luxury $650+ technical product.
The Pet Parent focuses strictly on pet food, supplies, and veterinary recommendations, which is entirely irrelevant to technical backcountry ski shells.
The Convenience-First Millennial relies on instant delivery and quick commerce, contrasting with a high-consideration $650+ luxury purchase.
The Value-Conscious Shopper has high price sensitivity and looks for discount-forward bundles, which directly contradicts the luxury pricing tier of the advertiser.
The Gifter is focused on temporary gifting holidays and gift-wrap messaging rather than core technical gear functionality needed by backcountry skiers.
